plan.explanation: Planar face F1 is machined first on M1 to establish the datum for all subsequent features. Features F3, F2, F4, F5, and F7 are processed on M2 (using pocket_milling or drilling/reaming as required). Feature F6 requires drilling followed by reaming on M2. Feature F8 is drilled and tapped on M4. Feature F9 is slotted on M3. All precedence constraints regarding the datum face and process ordering are respected.
assumptions: Tool IDs T1 through T8 are compatible with their respective operation types as defined in the tool_compatibility catalogue.
M2 is capable of drilling, reaming, and pocket milling simultaneously or sequentially without setup change penalties.
M3 slot_milling operation utilizes an end_mill (T7) despite M3 description emphasizing slotting capabilities.
uncertainties: Exact tool diameter for T6 vs T8 is not specified; assuming both drills can cover the required hole diameters.
M4 'Drill-tap unit' capability for drilling implies it has a drill tool; using T2 (drill) assumes compatibility with M4's spindle.
No collision checking performed between operations on different machines.
